summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S, a Danish foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a routine current report on Form 8-K) carrying its third-quarter 2026 earnings press release dated November 12, 2026. The release reports Q3 product revenue of €366 million (+89% Y/Y), split as €291 million YORVIPATH, €59 million SKYTROFA and €16 million YUVIWEL, and updates pipeline milestones including positive CHMP/COMP opinions for TransCon CNP with a final EC decision expected in Q4 2026 and a German launch planned for Q1 2027. No transaction, ownership change or board action is disclosed; the filing is an ordinary earnings update, so the risk-arb angle is absent and the focus is commercial execution and regulatory timing.
